question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Competent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Skilled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Competent"** refers to someone who has the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully. (योग्य)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a competent manager who handles her team efficiently.
 
 
 
• **"Skilled" **means having or showing a lot of ability and expertise in a specific area due to training or experience. (कुशल)
 
 
• **Example:** He is skilled in carpentry and can build beautiful furniture.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Competent' **is **'Skilled'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Skilled**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Humble **(विनम्र): Showing modesty or a lack of arrogance.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remains humble and down-to-earth.
 
 
 
• **Gracious **(दयालु): Courteous, kind, and pleasant in behavior or attitude.
 
 
• **Example:** She was gracious enough to forgive him for his mistake.
 
 
 
• **Ambitious** (महत्त्वाकांक्षी): Having a strong desire to achieve success or goals.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an ambitious entrepreneur aiming to expand his business globally.
